note:
The numbers the leveling planner needs that NO table in the pinned YuanShen dump publishes. Everything else it uses is derived into app/data/yuanshen/snapshot/planner_economy.json. Hand-maintained, which is why it lives outside snapshot/ -- that directory means 'derived from the pinned dump' and these are not.

All five are now filled (owner, 2026-09-07). RULE: an entry with a non-null value MUST carry a non-empty `source` naming where the number came from. tests/unit/test_planner_economy.py enforces it. A null value is not a bug -- the planner reports that source's resin as unknown rather than guessing, which is the same discipline as 'a skipped check is never a pass'.

These are keyed by SOURCE, not by material. Every trounce domain yields its materials the same way, so one number prices all 47 weekly-boss drops rather than 47 hand-typed entries -- and the rate genuinely is a property of the activity, not of the item.

What is NOT here, and why: elemental gems, common enemy drops and local specialties cost no resin at all (owner, 2026-09-07), so they need no rate. Gems in particular drop from a world boss alongside the boss material in the same 40-resin run, so charging for both would bill that run twice. See MaterialSource in app/services/planner/economy.py.

character.source: owner ruling, 2026-09-07: "there is no more per exp point conversion" — Genshin no longer charges mora for feeding EXP material.
character.comment: Feeding EXP books costs no mora. This is NOT the same as saying levelling is free: ascension and talent levels still charge mora, and those figures come from the payload's own `cost` fields rather than from here.

weapon.source: owner ruling, 2026-09-07: the same ruling covers Enhancement Ore.
weapon.comment: Feeding Enhancement Ore costs no mora.

weekly_boss.source: owner ruling, 2026-09-07: "2.2 named materials per run on average (always 2 or 3), randomly selected between 3 options for each boss". A boss carries three materials and each drop is one of them, so a NAMED material's expectation is 2.2 / 3.
weekly_boss.comment: **2.2 is the run's total across all three of the boss's materials; this field is one named material, so it is 2.2/3 = 0.733333.** Getting that split wrong scales every weekly-boss resin figure by three. `resin: 30` is the trounce cost and is still the least-confirmed number here — DungeonExcelConfigData does not price trounce domains.

ley_line_exp.source: owner ruling, 2026-09-07: at World Level 9, "6-7 blue xp books per ley line and 4-5 purple books", per 20 resin. Midpoints: 6.5 blue x 5,000 + 4.5 purple x 20,000 = 122,500 EXP.
ley_line_exp.comment: Character EXP **points** per Blossom of Revelation, not books. Blue is Adventurer's Experience (5,000) and purple is Hero's Wit (20,000); both values are read from MaterialExcelConfigData.itemUse rather than recalled. **Assumes World Level 9**, which the planner states rather than hides — yields scale with world level and this is one figure.

ley_line_mora.source: owner ruling, 2026-09-07: "For Mora it's 60,000 flat", per 20 resin, at World Level 9.
ley_line_mora.comment: Mora per Blossom of Wealth. Flat, not a distribution — it does not vary.
